description: Asset-lineage sibling of DynamicFanoutJobComponent. Wraps discover→map→collect via DynamicOut in a @graph_asset so the fan-out lives in the asset catalog.

outputs.description: Whatever collect returns, or the raw list of process results if no collect callable.

discover_callable_path.label: Discover Callable
discover_callable_path.description: module:function returning an iterable of items. Signature: discover(upstream=..., **discover_kwargs) → List[item].

process_callable_path.label: Process Callable
process_callable_path.description: module:function that takes one item and returns a result.

process_kwargs.label: Process Kwargs
process_kwargs.description: Static kwargs merged into each process call.

collect_callable_path.label: Collect Callable
collect_callable_path.description: Optional module:function that takes the list of results and returns the asset's final value.

mapping_key_field.label: Mapping Key Field
mapping_key_field.description: If items are dicts, use this field as the DynamicOutput mapping_key (stable per-item retries).

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Optional asset to depend on. Its materialized value passes into discover as upstream=X.

max_concurrent_tag_value.label: Max Concurrent Tag Value
max_concurrent_tag_value.description: If set, applies dagster/concurrency_key=<value> to the process op so an instance-level concurrency limit governs fan-out parallelism.

fail_on_empty.label: Fail On Empty
fail_on_empty.description: Fail the graph if discover returns no items.
